essays.text: The seemingly prevalent rise of far-right parties in Europe has raised concernsabout its potentially multifaceted impacts on the diplomatic efforts of Taiwan(R.O.C.). Draft an official response to these possible impacts.（25%）

In recent years, the German magazine Compact has frequently featuredinflammatory rhetoric and extremism, such as “Asylbombe” (asylum bomb)and “Impf-Diktatur” (vaccine dictatorship). A couple of months ago, GermanInterior Minister Nancy Faeser, citing threats to constitutional order and socialstability, banned this magazine and raided the magazine’s offices and theeditor’s home in various states. This action has ignited a debate within Germansociety regarding media freedom. Draft an official commentary on this pieceof news.（25%）

Draft an official commentary from the political, ethical, and moralconsiderations in an educational setting on the controversy surrounding freespeech that has arisen from U.S. students’ protests against Israel’s actions inthe Israel-Hamas conflict.（25%）
Draft an official commentary both on the United States’ 2001 withdrawal fromthe Kyoto Protocol and on its 2017 withdrawal from and 2021 re-entry intothe Paris Agreement.（25%）
